nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Starts Amazon Ads OAuth authorization or returns safe connection and profile metadata. Access and refresh tokens are never accepted or returned.

accountName.description: Optional display name for the authorization request.

connectionId.description: Required when operation=profiles. Owned Amazon Ads connection ID.

marketplaceId.description: Required when operation=authorize. Amazon marketplace identifier.

region.description: Required when operation=authorize. Amazon Ads region: NA, EU, or FE.

name: nexscope_amazon_ads_api_access
title: Amazon Ads API Access
